newsitem.title: UK: Co-op turnover rises in 1996, profits fall.
newsitem.headline: Co-op turnover rises in 1996, profits fall.

text.p: The Co-operative Movement's national retail turnover rose to almost eight billion stg during 1996, but aggregate trading profits slipped for the first time in seven years, the Co-operative Congress said on Sunday.
Sales rose by more than two percent to 7.95 billion stg from 7.78 billion stg, while profits fell to 136 million stg from 160 million stg, reflecting intense competition, the group said.
The Co-operative Union, the Movement's organising and advisory body, said consumer confidence was showing some signs of recovery although it was patchy, with wide regional variations.
